coverage_gap: No technical or software prose in any genre, which is most of what the watcher actually scans.

encyclopedia.note: Present-day expository prose, and the only genre here carrying citation and markup residue.

literature.note: Public domain books, mostly published before 1930 with a few modern exceptions, so the register is not contemporary.

news.note: Rows were scraped with ' . ' standing in for line breaks, so bylines and datelines split into fragments.

rejected_sources.Human.csv: A concatenation of Wikipedia.csv and Gutenberg.csv, so reading it would count the same sentences twice.
rejected_sources.Shuffled_Human.csv: A concatenation of Wikipedia.csv and Gutenberg.csv, so reading it would count the same sentences twice.
